chunks: Umm Salamah, may Allah be pleased with her, came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and said: “O Messenger of Allah, the time of al-Aḍḥā has come, and I do not have the price of the sacrificial animal. Shall I borrow and offer the sacrifice?”
He said: “Then borrow, for it is a debt that will be repaid.”

key_terms.الْأَضْحَى: the time of Eid al-Aḍḥā and its sacrificial observance
key_terms.الْأُضْحِيَّةِ: the sacrificial animal offered on Eid al-Aḍḥā
key_terms.ثَمَنُ: the price or cost required for purchase
key_terms.فَأَسْتَقْرِضُ: shall I take a loan or borrow money

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to take a loan in order to offer the sacrificial animal for Eid al-Aḍḥā?
ai.summary: This hadith indicates the permissibility of borrowing in order to perform the sacrificial offering of al-uḍḥiyah when one expects repayment to be manageable. It presents the Prophet’s صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم response as a practical legal ruling related to worship and financial capacity.
